pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit highly polygonal, multi-edged geometry with sharp, distinct pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch sizes are moderate, with consistent dark pigmentation and minimal internal tonal variation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous lattice structure. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is consistent across the mid-flank, creating a well-defined negative-space graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the upper neck and shoulder crest, creating a jagged interface against the background pixels.
